title: Apple removed scam apps that used a devious trick to steal from iPhone users — and it reveals a growing problem with the App Store (AAPL)
text:
Tim Cook
Monday, 3 December 2018 ( 17 hours ago )
· Scam apps for iPhones were discovered over the weekend that trick users into making in-app purchases they didn't mean to make.
· Sometimes these scams steal as much as $120 from a user.
· Apple hasn't commented but it removed the scam apps from its App Store over the weekend.
